(()=>{const tr=PT8.RING_IDX;PT8.launch({rally:true,circuit:true,mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:'merc',alt:0}],ai:[]});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.forceAI=1;c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};const T=RACE.T,N=T.N;const log=[];let prev=null;for(let i=0;i<60*60;i++){const y0=c.y,vy0=c.vy;step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count'&&i>60*20)RACE.state='race';if(RACE.state!=='race')continue;if(c.idx>=70&&c.idx<=100){const s=T.surf(c.x,c.z,c.y);let lat=0;{const k=c.idx,cc=Math.cos(T.psi[k]),ss=Math.sin(T.psi[k]);lat=(c.x-T.x[k])*cc-(c.z-T.z[k])*ss}log.push([c.idx,+(c.y-s.h).toFixed(2),+c.vy.toFixed(2),+(c._gv||0).toFixed(2),c.m.wheels.map(w=>w.g?1:0).join(''),Math.round(c.sp*3.6),+lat.toFixed(1),s.road?1:0,+c.pitch.toFixed(2),+(c.vy-vy0).toFixed(2)])}if(c.idx>100&&log.length)break}return JSON.stringify(log)})()
